body.zh-Hant: 1885年11月26日生於明斯特，父親是醋廠主兼酒商。他在慕尼黑與斯特拉斯堡讀歷史、法學與經濟學，1915年於波昂以英國鐵路國有化的論文取得博士學位；1915至1918年以志願兵身分參加第一次世界大戰，並取得軍官軍階。
body.en: Born in Münster on 26 November 1885, the son of a vinegar manufacturer and wine merchant. He studied history, law and economics in Munich and Strasbourg, took his doctorate at Bonn in 1915 with a thesis on the nationalisation of English railways, and served in the First World War as a volunteer from 1915 to 1918, reaching officer rank.

heading.en: Trade unions and the Centre Party

body.zh-Hant: 1919年他在柏林擔任天主教社會政策家兼普魯士福利部長亞當·施特格瓦爾德的私人幕僚；1920至1930年任基督教德意志工會聯盟的總幹事。1924年起他以中央黨議員身分進入帝國議會，1925年接手聯盟報刊《德意志人》的領導；1929年12月5日當選中央黨帝國議會黨團主席。
body.en: In 1919 he became personal adviser in Berlin to Adam Stegerwald, a Catholic social-policy figure and Prussian welfare minister. From 1920 to 1930 he was managing director of the Christian German Trade Union Federation. From 1924 he sat in the Reichstag for the Centre Party, in 1925 took over the federation's paper Der Deutsche, and on 5 December 1929 was elected chairman of the Centre parliamentary group in the Reichstag.

citations.quote: Sozialpolitikers und preußischen Wohlfahrtsministers Adam Stegerwald

body.zh-Hant: 德國歷史博物館的年表寫道，1930年3月30日大聯合內閣垮台後布呂寧出任帝國總理，組成少數政府並依賴總統的緊急命令權。1931年10月7日外交部長庫爾提烏斯去職，內閣隨之總辭；10月9日他在總理之外兼任外交部長。1932年5月30日，在施萊謝爾將軍推動下他被迫辭職，由巴本接任。
body.en: The German Historical Museum chronology says that on 30 March 1930, after the fall of the grand coalition, Brüning became Reich Chancellor, forming a minority government that relied on the president's emergency powers. On 7 October 1931 the cabinet resigned after Foreign Minister Curtius left office; on 9 October Brüning additionally took the foreign ministry. On 30 May 1932 he was forced to resign at General Schleicher's instigation, and Franz von Papen succeeded him.

heading.en: Party chairman, exile and later years

body.zh-Hant: 1933年5月6日至7月5日，布呂寧任中央黨主席，直到該黨自行解散。1934年他逃往荷蘭以避免被捕，隨後移居美國，1937至1951年在哈佛大學任政治學教授，1951至1955年任教於科隆大學。他於1970年3月30日在美國諾威治去世。
body.en: From 6 May to 5 July 1933 Brüning chaired the Centre Party until it dissolved itself. In 1934 he escaped arrest by fleeing to the Netherlands and then moved to the United States, where he was professor of political science at Harvard from 1937 to 1951 and at the University of Cologne from 1951 to 1955. He died in Norwich, USA, on 30 March 1970.

body.zh-Hant: 1872年10月6日生於瑞典西曼蘭的蒙克托普，父親是農民兼士兵。他早年當過雇工、鑄工學徒，後入商業學校。1897年他遷往埃斯基爾斯蒂納，在禁酒者疾病互助基金會任職；1899年起任聖殿騎士團（Templarorden）團長，在禁酒運動中累積威望。
body.en: Born on 6 October 1872 at Munktorp in Västmanland, the son of a farmer and soldier. He worked as a farmhand and foundry apprentice and attended a commercial school. In 1897 he moved to Eskilstuna to work for the temperance members' sickness fund, and from 1899 he headed the Templar Order, building his standing in the temperance movement.

citations.quote: lantbrukaren, grundläggaren och soldaten Carl Erik Ekman-Kraft
Några år var han dräng i hemsocknen
År 1897 blev han kassör i nykterhetsvännernas allmänna sjukkassa
vilket föranledde hans flyttning till Eskilstuna

body.zh-Hant: 1902年他進入埃斯基爾斯蒂納市議會，同年參與創立自由派的「自由思想者全國協會」（Frisinnade landsföreningen）。1911年起他代表耶夫勒堡省進入第一院，任議員至1928年；又曾在1916至1918年擔任國家審計員。1923年他出任自由思想人民黨主席。
body.en: In 1902 he entered the Eskilstuna town council and, the same year, took part in founding the Liberal Frisinnade landsföreningen. From 1911 he sat in the First Chamber for Gävleborg County, and he remained a member until 1928; he was also a state auditor in 1916-18. In 1923 he became chairman of the Frisinnade folkpartiet.

citations.quote: Samma år deltog han i grundandet av Frisinnade landsföreningen
År 1911 inträdde han som representant för Gävleborgs län i första kammaren

body.zh-Hant: 依《瑞典人物辭典》，埃克曼於1926年6月7日至1928年10月2日首度出任首相，並在1926年6月7日至9月30日兼任財政部長。瑞典政府官網的歷任首相頁也列出這段任期，但把就任寫成「1925年6月7日」，與該頁標題的1926至1928年不一致。
body.en: According to the Svenskt biografiskt lexikon, Ekman was prime minister for the first time from 7 June 1926 to 2 October 1928 and also headed the Finance Department from 7 June to 30 September 1926. The Swedish government's list of prime ministers gives the same term but writes the start as 7 June 1925, which conflicts with the page's own 1926-1928 heading.

citations.quote: Den 7 juni 1925 tillträdde Carl Gustaf Ekman som statsminister

heading.zh-Hant: 第二次出任首相與克魯格事件
heading.en: Second term and the Kreuger affair

body.zh-Hant: 1930年6月7日埃克曼第二度出任首相，至1932年8月6日辭職，其間1930年6月7日至1931年6月19日兼任國防部長。1932年3月12日克魯格自殺後，傳出埃克曼曾收受克魯格的政治獻金；他承認1931年10月收到5萬克朗。1934年8月人民黨成立後，他只進入新黨的信任委員會，未入執行委員會，此後不再有政治作用。
body.en: Ekman became prime minister a second time on 7 June 1930 and resigned on 6 August 1932, serving also as defence minister from 7 June 1930 to 19 June 1931. After Ivar Kreuger shot himself on 12 March 1932, rumours spread that Ekman had taken money from Kreuger; he admitted receiving 50,000 kronor in October 1931. When the Folkpartiet was formed in August 1934 he was elected only to its council, not its executive committee, and played no further political role.

han i oktober 1931 av Kreuger fått 50 000 kr för partiändamål

kom då icke att spela någon politisk roll

body.zh-Hant: 約翰（尤卡）·威廉·蘭格爾1894年10月25日生於瑞典語稱 Hauho 的豪霍。他在赫爾辛基大學讀法律，1922年取得法學候選人學位。1925年他任合作銀行機構 ACA 法務部主任，1933年起任該機構的總經理。《芬蘭人物辭典》稱他真正的職業生涯是銀行家。
body.en: Johan (Jukka) Wilhelm Rangell was born on 25 October 1894 at Hauho. He studied law at the University of Helsinki and took the degree of juris utriusque kandidat in 1922. In 1925 he became head of the legal department at the cooperative credit institution ACA and from 1933 he was its managing director. The Biografiskt lexikon för Finland says his real career was in banking.

citations.quote: År 1922 tog han examen som juris utriusque kandidat
utsågs till chef för juridiska avdelningen vid Andelskassornas
utnämndes Rangell till verkställande direktör för ACA
Sin egentliga yrkeskarriär gjorde han dock som bankman

heading.en: Bank of Finland and sports leadership

body.zh-Hant: 1937年蘭格爾進入芬蘭銀行理事會；冬季戰爭初期出任銀行代理總裁。他同時是體育領袖：1934年任芬蘭體操運動總會副主席，次年起任主席，並自1938年起兼任國際奧林匹克委員會委員。1938年赫爾辛基獲得1940年奧運主辦權後，他也擔任組織委員會主席。
body.en: In 1937 Rangell was elected to the board of the Bank of Finland and early in the Winter War he became its acting chief director. He was also a sports leader: vice-chairman of the Finnish Gymnastics and Athletics Federation in 1934, chairman the next year, and a member of the International Olympic Committee from 1938. After Helsinki was awarded the 1940 summer Games in 1938 he also chaired the organising committee.

citations.quote: År 1937 invaldes Rangell i Finlands Banks direktion
utnämndes till tf. chefdirektör för Finlands Bank
citations.evidenceNote: 來源寫「När Ryti i början av vinterkriget blev statsminister」，無精確日期

citations.quote: År 1934 blev Rangell FGIF:s vice ordförande

body.zh-Hant: 1941年1月他因是總統呂蒂的摯友而被任命為總理，不屬任何政黨。他的內閣首次納入極右翼愛國人民運動（IKL）的代表。《芬蘭人物辭典》說他是外交政策核心圈的一員，卻不是積極的決策者；1943年初呂蒂連任後組新政府，他被撇開，原因是他被認為過於親德。
body.en: He was appointed prime minister in January 1941 as a friend of President Ryti, belonging to no party. His government was the first to include a representative of the far-right Patriotic People's Movement (IKL). The Biografiskt lexikon för Finland says he belonged to the inner circle of foreign policy but was no active shaper of it; when a new government was formed after Ryti's re-election in early 1943 he was set aside because he was regarded as too pro-German.

citations.quote: Som vän till president Ryti utsågs han i januari 1941
För första gången ingick en representant
var han ingen aktiv utformare av
man ville byta ut statsministern, som ansågs alltför tyskvänlig

body.zh-Hant: 卸任後他回到芬蘭銀行總裁職位，1944年夏天隨呂蒂離開總統職位而辭去。戰後他在戰爭責任審判中被判六年徒刑，1949年2月21日獲釋，同年5月19日獲赦免。此後他進入 Kansallis-Osake-Pankki 的理事會並任副總裁，1951年重任芬蘭體操運動總會主席。他逝世於赫爾辛基，《人物辭典》記為1982年3月2日，而 Uppslagsverket 記為3月12日。
body.en: After leaving office he returned to the post of chief director of the Bank of Finland and resigned in the summer of 1944, when Ryti left the presidency. After the war he was sentenced in the war-responsibility trial to six years in prison, was released on 21 February 1949 and pardoned on 19 May 1949. He then joined the board of Kansallis-Osake-Pankki as deputy chief director and in 1951 resumed the chairmanship of the sports federation. He died in Helsinki; the Biografiskt lexikon gives 2 March 1982 and Uppslagsverket 12 March.
